label: case_study
instruction:
Content type: case study.
Client (anonymized): a movement-therapy studio, ~8 people.
Problem: manual appointment booking took 2 hours a day; leads that came in on weekends and after hours only got a reply on Monday morning.
Solution: automated booking + instant confirmation email + Notion calendar sync + 24h reminder.
Result: 0 manual booking work, 24/7 availability, 3 after-hours bookings recovered in week one.
